subject: 4060 Mystic Valley Parkway Life Science Facility
overview: The Medford Zoning Board of Appeals met remotely to consider several residential variance and finding requests alongside a major commercial proposal. The Board approved a permit extension for Edward Street, a finding for Summer Street, a lot width variance for Spring Street, and variances and site plan approval for an eight-story life science laboratory on Mystic Valley Parkway.

items.title: 17 Edward Street Permit Extension
items.summary: Approved a six-month extension of a special permit finding to construct a second-story addition and convert a single-family dwelling into a two-family home.

items.title: 29 Summer Street Special Permit Finding
items.summary: Approved a finding that constructing a third-story addition to an existing four-unit dwelling would not be substantially more detrimental to the neighborhood.

items.title: 0 Spring Street Lot Width Variance
items.summary: Approved a lot width variance to erect a single-family home on an existing lot measuring 48 feet wide where 50 feet is required.

items.title: 4060 Mystic Valley Parkway Life Science Facility
items.summary: Approved variances for building height, lot coverage, and loading bays, and granted site plan review approval subject to 14 conditions to allow demolition of an existing commercial structure and construction of an eight-story laboratory facility.

items.title: Administrative Updates and Board Business
items.summary: Discussed scheduling upcoming board member training, assigning draft decision writing among members, and procedural updates on pending Chapter 40B applications.
